info.name: Sofar Ocean Spotter & Devices Smart Mooring API

params.name: spotterId
params.description: The Spotter ID of the device to retrieve data from.

params.name: startDate
params.description: ISO 8601 start date (defaults to 24 hours ago).

params.name: includeSoundPressureReadings
params.description: Set true to return sound pressure level (SPL) readings from hydrophone Spotters via cellular.

items.docs: Returns Smart Mooring sensor data collected and transmitted by a Spotter, specified by spotterId, between startDate and endDate.

info.name: Get Smart Mooring sensor configuration history

params.name: spotterId
params.description: The Spotter ID of the device to retrieve configurations from.

params.name: startDate
params.description: ISO 8601 start date for the configuration window.

params.name: endDate
params.description: ISO 8601 end date for the configuration window.

items.docs: Retrieve Smart Mooring sensor configurations from a Spotter for a specified time window. Configurations can be cross-referenced with the configuration_checksum returned by the Sensor Data endpoint.
